name: Saltwind
summary: A frosted glass sign-in over a moonlit coast with a sleepy moon and a sweeping lighthouse beam
about: A full sign-in page set on a night coast: stars twinkle, shooting stars fall, waves roll under a shimmering moon path and two lantern boats bob near a lighthouse. The sleepy moon watches your cursor and your typing, hides behind a cloud for the password and cheers when you sign in. Good for apps, travel and creative brands that want a calm, premium login.
how: The page fades in: the moon rises, the cliff slides in and the glass card floats up with its fields one after another
Type your email and the moon's eyes follow the caret while the lighthouse beam swings over to light the card
Focus the password and a cloud drifts over the moon's eyes; press the eye button and the cloud thins so the moon peeks with one eye
Press Sign in: the button fills like a tide gauge while the moon thinks, then a wrong password makes the sea choppy and the moon frown
With the demo details the beam spins a full circle, shooting stars and sparkles burst and a welcome panel slides in
Sign out resets everything smoothly; the perks below the form slide up as you scroll
